text_en: Then Solomon said, “The Lord has said that he would reside in thick darkness.
text_cn: 当时撒罗满说：“上主曾决定：要住在幽暗之中；

text_en: I have built you an exalted house, a place for you to reside in forever. ”
text_cn: 我却为你建筑了一个居所，作为你永久的住处。”

text_en: Then the king turned around and blessed all the assembly of Israel, while all the assembly of Israel stood.
text_cn: 君王遂转过脸来，祝福了以色列全会众；以色列全会众都站着，

text_en: And he said, “Blessed be the Lord , the God of Israel, who with his hand has fulfilled what he promised with his mouth to my father David, saying,
text_cn: 撒罗满说：“上主，以色列的天主，应受赞美！他亲口对我父亲达味应许过，也亲手完成了说：

text_en: ‘Since the day that I brought my people out of the land of Egypt, I have not chosen a city from any of the tribes of Israel in which to build a house, so that my name might be there, and I chose no one as ruler over my people Israel;
text_cn: 自从我领我的百姓出离埃及地的那天起，没有在以色列各支派中，选择一城，为建造一座作我名下的殿，也没有拣选一个人作领袖，管理我的百姓以色列。

text_en: but I have chosen Jerusalem in order that my name may be there, and I have chosen David to be over my people Israel. ’
text_cn: 可是，我选择了耶路撒冷作为安置我名之处，拣选了达味管理我的百姓以色列。

text_en: My father David had it in mind to build a house for the name of the Lord , the God of Israel.
text_cn: 我父亲达味原有意为上主以色列天主的名建造一座殿，

text_en: But the Lord said to my father David, ‘You did well to consider building a house for my name;
text_cn: 但上主却对我父亲达味说：你有意为我的名建造一座殿，你这番心意固然很好，

text_en: nevertheless you shall not build the house, but your son who shall be born to you shall build the house for my name. ’
text_cn: 但不是你要建造这殿，而是你亲生的儿子，他要为我的名建造这殿。

text_en: Now the Lord has fulfilled his promise that he made; for I have succeeded my father David, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the Lord promised, and have built the house for the name of the Lord , the God of Israel.
text_cn: 现在上主实现了他所说的话，使我来继承了我父亲达味，坐上了以色列的宝座，正如上主所预许的；我也为上主以色列天主的名建造了这座殿，

text_en: There I have set the ark, in which is the covenant of the Lord that he made with the people of Israel. ”
text_cn: 将约柜安放在里面；约柜内有上主与以色列子民所立的约版。”

text_en: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the Lord in the presence of the whole assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands.
text_cn: 以后，撒罗满当着以色列全会众的面，站在上主的祭坛前，伸开手，──

text_en: Solomon had made a bronze platform five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high, and had set it in the court; and he stood on it. Then he knelt on his knees in the presence of the whole assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands toward heaven.
text_cn: 因为撒罗满制造了一座铜台，长五肘，宽五肘，高三肘，安置在庭院中央，他立在上面，当着以色列全会众的面，屈膝跪拜，举手向天，──

text_en: He said, “O Lord , God of Israel, there is no God like you, in heaven or on earth, keeping covenant in steadfast love with your servants who walk before you with all their heart—
text_cn: 说“上主，以色列的天主！上天下地，没有一个神可与你相比。你对那些一心在你面前行走的仆人，常是遵守信约，表示慈爱。

text_en: you who have kept for your servant, my father David, what you promised to him. Indeed, you promised with your mouth and this day have fulfilled with your hand.
text_cn: 你对你仆人，我父亲达味所应许的，你都履行了；你亲口应许的，你也亲手成就了，正如今天一样。

text_en: Therefore, O Lord , God of Israel, keep for your servant, my father David, that which you promised him, saying, ‘There shall never fail you a successor before me to sit on the throne of Israel, if only your children keep to their way, to walk in my law as you have walked before me. ’
text_cn: 上主，以色列的天主！你曾说：只要你的子孙谨守他们的道路，按照我的法律行走，如你在我面前行走一样，你决断不了在我前坐以色列王位的人；现在求你实践你对你仆人，我父亲达味所说的话吧！

text_en: Therefore, O Lord , God of Israel, let your word be confirmed, which you promised to your servant David.
text_cn: 上主，以色列的天主，现在求你使你向你仆人达味所应许过的话，予以实现吧！

text_en: “But will God indeed reside with mortals on earth? Even heaven and the highest heaven cannot contain you, how much less this house that I have built!
text_cn: 天主实在与人住在地上吗？看，天和天上的天，尚且容不下你，何况我所建造的这座殿宇呢！

text_en: Regard your servant’s prayer and his plea, O Lord my God, heeding the cry and the prayer that your servant prays to you.
text_cn: 上主，我的天主，请垂允你仆人的祈祷和恳求！俯听你仆人在你面前所发的呼号和祈祷！

text_en: May your eyes be open day and night toward this house, the place where you promised to set your name, and may you heed the prayer that your servant prays toward this place.
text_cn: 愿你的眼睛昼夜垂视这座殿，看顾你所说，你要安置你名的地方；求你垂听你仆人向这地方所行的祈祷！

text_en: And hear the plea of your servant and of your people Israel, when they pray toward this place; may you hear from heaven your dwelling place; hear and forgive.
text_cn: 愿你垂听你仆人与你百姓以色列向这地方所发的哀祷，求你从天上，由你的居所，予以垂听，垂听和宽恕！

text_en: “If someone sins against another and is required to take an oath and comes and swears before your altar in this house,
text_cn: 若有人得罪了自己的邻人，被迫以咒词起誓，而来到这殿内，在你祭坛前起誓，

text_en: may you hear from heaven, and act, and judge your servants, repaying the guilty by bringing their conduct on their own head, and vindicating those who are in the right by rewarding them in accordance with their righteousness.
text_cn: 求你由天上垂听受理，为你的仆人伸冤：惩治恶人，照他所行的，报应在他头上；宣告义人无罪，照他的正义酬报他。

text_en: “When your people Israel, having sinned against you, are defeated before an enemy but turn again to you, confess your name, pray and plead with you in this house,
text_cn: 如果你的百姓以色列，因为得罪了你，在敌人面前被击败；他们如果回心转意，称颂你的名，在这殿内向你祈祷恳求，

text_en: may you hear from heaven, and forgive the sin of your people Israel, and bring them again to the land that you gave to them and to their ancestors.
text_cn: 愿你从天上予以垂听，宽恕你百姓以色列的罪，领他们回到你赐给他们并他们祖先的地方！

text_en: “When heaven is shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against you, and then they pray toward this place, confess your name, and turn from their sin, because you punish them,
text_cn: 几时他们犯罪得罪了你，天空闭塞不雨，你惩罚了他们；他们如果向这地方祈祷，称颂你的名，远离罪过，

text_en: may you hear in heaven, forgive the sin of your servants, your people Israel, when you teach them the good way in which they should walk; and send down rain upon your land, which you have given to your people as an inheritance.
text_cn: 求你从天上垂听，赦免你仆人及你百姓以色列的罪，指给他们应走的正路，使雨降在你赐予你百姓作为基业的地上。

text_en: “If there is famine in the land, if there is plague, blight, mildew, locust, or caterpillar; if their enemies besiege them in any of the settlements of the lands; whatever suffering, whatever sickness there is;
text_cn: 如果此地发生饥馑、瘟疫，五谷枯萎生霉，或遭受蝗虫或蚂蚱，或有敌人犯境围困门下，或不拘遭受什么灾祸疾病，

text_en: whatever prayer, whatever plea from any individual or from all your people Israel, all knowing their own suffering and their own sorrows so that they stretch out their hands toward this house;
text_cn: 你的百姓以色列，个人或团体，如果感觉内疚和痛苦，而向这殿伸出手来祈祷哀求，

text_en: may you hear from heaven, your dwelling place, forgive, and render to all whose heart you know, according to all their ways, for only you know the human heart.
text_cn: 愿你从天上，你的居所，予以俯听宽恕，照每人的一切行为，予以赏报，因为你认识每个人的心，──唯有你认识人子的心，

text_en: Thus may they fear you and walk in your ways all the days that they live in the land that you gave to our ancestors.
text_cn: 使他们在你赐予我们祖先的地上，一生一世敬畏你，在你的道路上行走！

text_en: “Likewise when foreigners, who are not of your people Israel, come from a distant land because of your great name, and your mighty hand, and your outstretched arm, when they come and pray toward this house,
text_cn: 至于那不属你百姓以色列的外方人，为了你的大名，你有力的手及伸开的臂，自远方来，在这殿内祈祷，

text_en: may you hear from heaven your dwelling place, and do whatever the foreigners ask of you, in order that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you, as do your people Israel, and that they may know that your name has been invoked on this house that I have built.
text_cn: 愿你从天上，你的居所垂听，按照外方人所请求于你的去行！这样，可使地上万民都认识你的名，敬畏你，如同你的百姓以色列一样；使他们知道我所建造的这殿，是属于你名下的。

text_en: “If your people go out to battle against their enemies, by whatever way you shall send them, and they pray to you toward this city that you have chosen and the house that I have built for your name,
text_cn: 你的人民，如果在你派遣他们走的路上与敌人交战，而他们向你所拣选的这城，向我为你的名所建的这殿，祈求你，

text_en: then hear from heaven their prayer and their plea, and maintain their cause.
text_cn: 愿你从天上俯听他们的祈祷和哀求，维护他们的正义！

text_en: “If they sin against you—for there is no one who does not sin—and you are angry with them and give them to an enemy, so that they are carried away captive to a land far or near;
text_cn: 如果他们犯罪得罪你，──因为没有不犯罪的人，──你向他们发怒，将他们交于仇敌，让敌人将他们掳到远方或近处。

text_en: then if they come to their senses in the land to which they have been taken captive, and repent, and plead with you in the land of their captivity, saying, ‘We have sinned, and have done wrong; we have acted wickedly’;
text_cn: 他们若在被掳往的地方，回心转意，在充军之地，恳求你说：我们犯了罪，我们作了恶，做了背理的事；

text_en: if they repent with all their heart and soul in the land of their captivity, to which they were taken captive, and pray toward their land, which you gave to their ancestors, the city that you have chosen, and the house that I have built for your name,
text_cn: 如果他们在被掳充军之地，全心全意归向你，向你赐给他们祖先的地方，向你所拣选的这城，向我为你的名所建的这殿祈祷，

text_en: then hear from heaven your dwelling place their prayer and their pleas, maintain their cause and forgive your people who have sinned against you.
text_cn: 愿你从天上，你的居所，垂听他们的祈祷和恳求，维护他们的正义，宽恕得罪你的百姓！

text_en: Now, O my God, let your eyes be open and your ears attentive to prayer from this place.
text_cn: 现在，我的天主，愿你的眼睛睁着，侧耳谛听在这地方所行的祈祷！

text_en: “Now rise up, O Lord God, and go to your resting place, you and the ark of your might. Let your priests, O Lord God, be clothed with salvation, and let your faithful rejoice in your goodness.
text_cn: 现在，上主天主，愿你起来，愿你与你那大能的约柜进入你安息之所！上主天主，愿你的司祭身披救援，愿你的圣徒在幸福中欢乐！

text_en: O Lord God, do not reject your anointed one. Remember your steadfast love for your servant David. ”
text_cn: 上主天主，求你不要摒（bìng）弃你的受傅者，记念你赐予你仆人达味的慈爱！”
